rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for answering or replying to someone.

example.english: You asked me, so I respond to you.
example.jyutping: nei5 man6 ngo5 ngo5 mai6 daap3 nei5 lo1

rows.note: Use this especially for replying to a message or to someone who is waiting for a reply.

example.english: I’ll respond to your message later.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 fuk1 nei5 go3 seon3 sik1

rows.note: Use this for reacting to a stimulus, event, or force rather than giving a verbal reply.

example.english: This button will respond when you press it.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zai3 jat1 on3 zau6 jau5 faan2 jing3
